summary.text: Steven Woodrow is a Democrat who represents District 2 (Denver) in the Colorado House of Representatives; Ballotpedia lists him as not running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Woodrow was born in Detroit, Michigan, earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Michigan in 2002 and a J.D. from Chicago-Kent College of Law in 2005.
It lists his career as attorney and adjunct law professor at Chicago-Kent, including work for Judge Anne C. Williams of the Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals.
